name: Input Assist (Testing)
description: Trajectory preview, click assist and auto-orb for testing sections in practice mode / editor playtest.

practice-only.name: Practice / playtest only
practice-only.description: Only run in practice mode or editor playtest, so normal attempts and progress are never affected. Leave this on.

preview.name: Trajectory preview
preview.description: Green line = path if you hold now. Red line = path if you let go now. A dot marks where that path dies.

preview-seconds.name: Preview length (s)
preview-seconds.description: Longer previews cost more CPU every frame.

click-assist.name: Click assist
click-assist.description: Delays your tap by a few ms if that is what it takes to survive. It can only delay a click, never make it earlier.

assist-window-ms.name: Assist window (ms)
assist-window-ms.description: Max delay the assist may add to a click.

assist-horizon-ms.name: Assist look-ahead (ms)
assist-horizon-ms.description: How far ahead a click must survive to count as good.

auto-orb.name: Auto orb / ring
auto-orb.description: Clicks automatically while you overlap an orb. (Pads already trigger on touch in vanilla GD.)
